user_intent: authorize permissions needed by the mission rather than permanent privilege
keep the Golden Triangle running while the primary control console receives new messages
enable the platform execution connection/trigger for worker activation
new windows/workers replace an existing slot through handoff instead of creating a fourth slot

main_scope.purpose: enable a reviewed mission-specific read-only wake/spawn heartbeat and Reality ACK for LCR-METABOLISM-0003

launcher_permissions.candidate_mutation: must remain in separately authorized B worker scope

wake_acceptance: a real GitHub-hosted workflow run is created from the reviewed launcher
the runner reads the authoritative development branch state
A/B/C isolated jobs are instantiated without repository write permission
the active role validates current pending packet canonical SHA when applicable
wake evidence records state/role/packet identity but no secret values or raw worksite content
the launcher remains fail-closed for deadline, mission mismatch, backup>2, slot>3, packet tamper or consumed replay
expiration: consume/dormancy-lock after LCR-METABOLISM-0003 reaches IDLE/PASS, terminal HUMAN_GATE requiring new authorization, or explicit revocation
